title: MarsWalk Mission Request
description: Canonical specification for an interactive or automated Mars surface traverse mission planning request.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the MarsWalk API request schema.

mission_id.description: Optional unique or human-readable mission identifier.

start.description: Mission departure point on the digital elevation grid.

goal.description: Mission destination landmark on the digital elevation grid.

stops.description: Ordered or unordered list of intermediate science targets to visit.

id.description: Unique identifier for this science waypoint.

priority_score.description: User-defined or heuristic scientific value (0-100). Not an official NASA science ranking.

dwell_time_s.description: Target-specific dwell duration in seconds for science operations.

profile.description: Routing objective profile: conservative (least effort), balanced (Pareto trade-off), science_first (maximal samples).

vehicle_mode.description: Mobility operational model: crew_eva (Apollo walk analogue, 8h envelope) or robotic_rover (0.035 m/s, 4h sol window).

mission_constraints.description: Operational budget limitations and pacing assumptions.

max_distance_m.description: Hard limit on total path distance in metres.

max_duration_s.description: Hard ceiling on total mission elapsed time in seconds.

dwell_time_per_stop_s.description: Default science dwell time per intermediate target in seconds (default 15 min).

speed_multiplier.description: Scale factor on nominal velocity (e.g. 0.5 for degraded mobility).

optimize_stops.description: When true, calculates the optimal visitation sequence using exact TSP (k<=7) or 2-Opt (k>7).

science_appetite_gamma.description: Weight exponent for science priority rewards in balanced/science_first profiles.

science_objectives.description: Optional list of target science objective IDs required for the mission.
